title: Player Sheet
description: Drag the mini player up and it becomes the full player in one continuous shape: the bar's outline grows into the sheet, the cover flies from the bar to the hero on a slight arc, the sheet's white turns into a flat colour taken from the artwork, and the library sinks back into a card. Catch it mid-flight, fling it, or drag it back down to dismiss.
intent: One drag progress drives the whole morph, so the gesture can be caught, reversed and flung at any point.
